summary: V031_RELEASE_READY: BLOCKED — the prepared release target fae8cd8aee7b07159308760d113f4bdec7139996 passes version identity, frozen install, standalone normal-resolver installation, deterministic tests, client build, package audits, publish dry-run, and public absence checks. The official DSH resolver-lock gate did not complete within the environment's safe resource/time boundary, so publication is not authorized by this gate.

tests.name: T01 Task Contract, branch, ancestry, and worktree safety
tests.evidence: The task validator returned VALID TASK CONTRACT. After checkout/pull, main was at 75cc90b6328f5f4d5c1ca232cfd091aef615becd and matched origin/main with a clean pre-execution status. The exact prepared release target fae8cd8aee7b07159308760d113f4bdec7139996 was verified as an ancestor and was used in a separate detached worktree; the queued task commit was not used as the package/tag target.

tests.name: T02 Prepared release-target version identity
tests.evidence: In the detached fae8cd8aee7b07159308760d113f4bdec7139996 worktree, package.json reported version 0.3.1, src/runtime-identity.mjs contained RUNTIME_VERSION 0.3.1, and the top CHANGELOG.md entry was ## 0.3.1 — 2026-08-22.

tests.name: T03 Frozen dependency installation
tests.evidence: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile exited 0 in the prepared release-target worktree. The lockfile remained unchanged and the target worktree was clean after installation.

tests.name: T04 Packed candidate standalone normal-resolver install
tests.evidence: pnpm run verify:npm-install returned NPM_INSTALL_CONTRACT=PASS candidate=0.3.1 official_dsh=not-run. The candidate tarball was materially installed in a disposable directory with npm's normal resolver and no peer-resolution bypass.

tests.name: T05 Candidate with official DSH resolver-lock cohort
tests.evidence: pnpm run verify:npm-install:official invoked the prepared resolver-only mode using npm's default resolver and --package-lock-only. The npm child ran for approximately 11 minutes, consumed about 1.3 GB working set with sustained high CPU, emitted no completion or PASS evidence, and was stopped safely. No --legacy-peer-deps, --force, --omit=peer, or equivalent bypass was used, and the full official graph was not materialized.

tests.name: T06 Full deterministic test sweep
tests.evidence: node --test test/*.test.mjs exited 0: 426 passed, 0 failed, 0 cancelled, 0 skipped.

tests.name: T07 Client build and generated-artifact boundary
tests.evidence: pnpm run build:client exited 0 and built lib/client.js. The deterministic tracked build side effect was restored in the disposable target worktree, leaving it clean.

tests.name: T08 npm pack dry-run and payload audit
tests.evidence: npm pack --dry-run --json reported @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.1, 86 files, unpacked size 1,611,105 bytes, tarball size 892,630 bytes, and integrity metadata. The payload audit passed with no ACTIVE task/result, temporary, secret, credential, node_modules, or test-only entries.

tests.name: T09 Non-publishing npm publish dry-run
tests.evidence: npm publish --dry-run --access public exited 0 from the exact prepared release-target worktree and reported @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.1 with tag latest/public access in dry-run mode. No registry mutation occurred.

tests.name: T10 Public npm absence of 0.3.1
tests.evidence: The authoritative public npm packument returned HTTP 200, dist-tags.latest=0.3.0, and no versions entry for 0.3.1.

tests.name: T11 Remote v0.3.1 tag absence
tests.evidence: git ls-remote --refs origin refs/tags/v0.3.1* returned no refs; the remote v0.3.1 tag is absent.

tests.name: T12 GitHub Release v0.3.1 absence
tests.evidence: The public GitHub Releases API lookup for v0.3.1 returned HTTP 404, confirming that no matching Release exists.

tests.name: T13 Final diff, status, and isolation hygiene
tests.evidence: The prepared target worktree passed git diff --check and was clean after restoring the build artifact. The main worktree remained clean before Result Contract assembly; the detached target worktree and task-created temporary directories were removed.
